name: mailhush
description: Mask emails, phone numbers, card numbers, API keys, and other personal data on any website before you share your screen.
author: OpenAI Codex

scripts.package: mkdir -p build && node scripts/fix-run-at.js && plasmo package
scripts.package:firefox: mkdir -p build && node scripts/fix-run-at.js && plasmo package --target=firefox-mv2
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p build && git archive --format=zip --output=build/mailhush-source-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").zip HEAD -- .gitignore BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md README.md assets bun.lock package.json scripts/fix-run-at.js src tests tsconfig.json

manifest.name: MailHush
manifest.description: Mask emails, phone numbers, cards, IBANs, API keys, and your own patterns on any page while keeping its styling intact.
